decision.reopen_trigger: After the October 24 first-session gate, reopen only on a new dated official product/rule/hours revision plus a distinct current calculation question; do not mechanically refresh generic weekend-CFD content.
decision.rationale: The official announcement plus two independent same-day English reports creates a new, specific product-discovery path. The reader's natural task is contract/specification verification followed by variable point-value exposure, not an index prediction or generic weekend-trading article.
